label: Deck audit
errors: {count, plural, =0 {No errors} one {# error} other {# errors}}
warnings: {count, plural, =0 {no warnings} one {# warning} other {# warnings}}
cleanHint: The audit runs by itself after every edit: overlaps, text past its box, slide edges, template margins, contrast, filler text and fonts.
status: {errors, plural, =0 {} other {Errors: #.}} {warnings, plural, =0 {} other {Warnings: #.}} Open the audit
statusClean: No problems found. Open the audit
slideBadge: {errors, plural, =0 {} one {# error} other {# errors}}{both, select, true {, } other {}}{warnings, plural, =0 {} one {# warning} other {# warnings}}

overflow.title: Text does not fit its box
overflow.detail: “{name}” runs {overflowPt} pt past a box {boxPt} pt tall. Shorten the text or enlarge the box.

covered.title: A shape hides content
covered.detail: Shape “{name}” lies on top of “{other}” and hides it.

pictureEdge.title: Object on the edge of a picture
pictureEdge.detail: Only part of “{name}” is on the picture. Put it wholly on the picture or beside it.

edge.title: Crosses the slide edge
edge.detail: “{name}” is {pastPt} pt past the edge: the show and the file cut that part off.

outside.title: Object off the slide
outside.detail: “{name}” lies wholly past the edge: neither the show nor the file shows it.

margin.title: Past the template margins
margin.detail: “{name}” crosses the template margin by {pastPt} pt.

filler.title: Filler text
filler.detail: “{name}” still says “{pattern}”: text like that must not reach an audience.

empty.title: Empty text box
empty.detail: It shows nothing in a slide show. Fill it in or delete it.

contrast.title: Low text contrast
contrast.detail: “{name}” contrasts with its background at {ratio}:1; it needs at least {required}:1.

font.title: Font “{font}” is not on this computer
font.detail: The slides show a stand-in; the file keeps “{font}”. Used on {slides, plural, one {# slide} other {# slides}}.
